units.source_text: 它好似窗玻璃的框架，支配着这风景的画面。

en.t: It was like the frame of a windowpane, controlling the composition of this landscape.

units.source_text: 为了把他紧紧地捆绑在写实的范畴里，它担任着风景测量器的角色。

en.t: In order to bind him tightly within the realm of realism, it took on the role of a measuring instrument for the landscape.
